item.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
item.description: Source: OpenAI News — ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.

item.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation

item.description: Source: The Hechinger Report — Artificial intelligence makes many tasks faster and easier. But a new study suggests that students may learn more when AI makes them slow down.
